detail.longDescription: NOT the solution I was expecting. I just gave it --webroot /tmp. The client thinks it did an http-01 check even though the CA never does because 1) I used a eab key/mac and 2) its a private IP that the CA can't get to. That worked and seems stupid, but I guess if its stupid and works, it ain't stupid. I still have to put the newly issued cert in the right place for the docker container to slurp up, but hey, this do. # acme # docker # httpd
